head: 82cb2a3acccc852bba6a7ef9c706c337ba9fe765
purpose: Pre-edit preservation inventory for P06: existing tests can be adapted/moved, never added without request. This is static source metadata, not execution or a Rust parser/quality probe.
scope: Handwritten src/examples in four tactical crates; candidate entries are not all proposed changes. Generated STDB bindings and unrelated crates excluded.
limitations: Regex names/counts are consistency evidence, not exhaustive macro/config coverage. Hosted nonempty test selections remain required.
Moving existing tests can change file/module ownership while preserving the function names/cases/assertions across the moved set.
Recorded hashes anchor all unchanged source and distinguish existing fixture edits from new tests; no test/case/helper was created.
